summary: The company filed an 8-K reporting settlement agreements in a shareholder lawsuit. From June 2-5, 2026, Kartoon Studios entered into settlements with five parties in the Augenbaum v. Anson Investments Master Fund LP case, receiving aggregate payments of $28.475 million minus plaintiff counsel fees and expenses. The court has approved three settlements; two await approval. The parties agreed to mutual releases. This is a litigation resolution, not a special-situation corporate transaction. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic changes are involved. No further analysis required.
